comments: 'Vertiv Avocent ACS8000 advanced console server, the 8-port single-AC unit, 1U. It has 8 RJ45
  serial ports, an RJ45 console port, two 10/100/1000 RJ45 LAN ports and two SFP cages. The maker''s front
  carries one AC inlet with its power switch. It also has a digital-in jack, a sensor jack, six USB ports
  and an SD card slot. On the rear it carries the serial ports, the console port, two more USB ports,
  the LAN ports and three lamps. The first two serial ports take RS-232, RS-422 or RS-485. The AC inlet
  is on the face the rack mounting guide fits the brackets to, so it is the front here.


  Configuration `base`: ACS8008SAC-400, the 8-port unit with a single AC power supply. The rack mounting
  brackets and screws are supplied with the unit (Rack Mounting Guide 590-1510-501C).

  Facts carried in the model that this schema has no field for:

  - compliance.certification: Emissions and immunity: FCC Class A, CE Class A, ICES-003, VCCI, RCM, KCC,
  BSMI, UKCA. Safety: UL, cUL, EN/IEC 62368-1, BSMI, BIS, NOM, UKCA. The cellular approvals are for cellular
  models (data sheet).

  - environmental.operating-humidity: 20% to 80% non-condensing RH

  - environmental.operating-temp-c: -10 to 60

  - environmental.storage-humidity: 5% to 95% non-condensing RH

  - environmental.storage-temp-c: -20 to 70

  - features.optics-sfp: 1 Gb SFP fibre modules (data sheet benefits, "Integrated support for 1Gb SFP
  fiber modules")

  - features.sensor-ports: environmental sensor port (RJ45, 1-wire) and four digital-in ports on the one
  DIGITAL IN jack (data sheet)

  - features.serial-pinout: automatic Cyclades and Cisco pin-out conversion (data sheet)

  - physical.weight-note: 6.4 to 7.2 lb for the line (data sheet); no weight is given for this model

  - platform.cpu: Dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 MPCore with CoreSight

  - platform.ram: 1 GB DDR3L

  - platform.storage: 16 GB eMMC flash

  - power.power-input: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 1 A, one C14 inlet (inlet legend and data sheet)

  - power.power-max-w: 28

  - power.power-usage: typical 6.2 W (0.13 A) at 120 VAC and 7 W (0.10 A) at 240 VAC; maximum 28 W at
  both (data sheet)
